name: A SPRIG OF PARSLEY
note: EXTRACTED from docs/121-the-not-done-list.md (THE LINES) by tools/extract-content.mjs (errata 250). Do not edit: change doc 121 and re-run. Off the contract at the Colonel's dinner. It goes in the raccoon's lapel in Act III.

LOOK_AT.say: The parsley off the Colonel's contract. It is the only part of that dinner I got away with.
repeat: Fresh, and curled, and grown under glass somewhere at great expense, to sit on a legal document.
It has not wilted. Nothing of the Colonel's does.

LISTEN_TO.say: Nothing. It was a garnish. It was never asked its views.
repeat: A small green squeak, between my fingers.
Nothing. It is keeping fresh out of spite.
